mapper.sql: WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.deleted=0 AND a.project_id=#{projectId} AND COALESCE(a.assigned_window_id,a.window_id)=#{windowId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) FROM rel_release_application a
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.subsystem_code) FROM rel_release_application a

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(a.subsystem_code,':',d.item_key)) FROM rel_release_application a JOIN rel_application_delivery d ON d.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND d.application_id=a.id AND d.active=1 AND d.item_type='DELIVERY_UNIT'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(a.subsystem_code,':',d.item_key)) FROM rel_release_application a JOIN rel_application_delivery d ON d.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND d.application_id=a.id AND d.active=1 AND d.item_type='FILE_MEDIA'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.requirement_code) FROM rel_release_application a JOIN rel_application_requirement r ON r.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND r.application_id=a.id AND r.active=1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.window_id) FROM rel_release_application a AND a.window_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT a.version_type metric,COUNT(*) amount FROM rel_release_application a GROUP BY a.version_type
SELECT p.production_result metric,COUNT(*) amount FROM rel_production_entry p JOIN rel_release_application a ON a.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND a.id=p.application_id GROUP BY p.production_result
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) FROM rel_release_application a LEFT JOIN rel_production_entry p ON p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND p.application_id=a.id AND p.active_candidate=1

SELECT application_code,project_name,subsystem_code,subsystem_name,version_type,characteristic,application_status,approved_at,production_result FROM (SELECT DISTINCT a.application_code,a.project_name,a.subsystem_code,a.subsystem_name,a.version_type,a.characteristic,a.application_status,a.approved_at,p.production_result,a.updated_at sort_updated_at,a.id sort_id FROM rel_release_application a LEFT JOIN rel_production_entry p ON p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND p.application_id=a.id AND p.active_candidate=1 ) drilldown_rows ORDER BY sort_updated_at DESC,sort_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
